mapper.select: SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM mst.bsn_part ORDER BY sort_seq,bsn_part_id
SELECT bsn_part_id AS id,bsn_part_nm AS name,hq_yn='Y' AS hq FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,bsn_part_id

SELECT part_std_hist_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt, CASE WHEN aply_bgn_ym > #{month} THEN '예정' WHEN aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month} THEN '적용 중' ELSE '지난 기준' END AS status FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC,part_std_hist_id DESC
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND use_yn='Y' AND (rsgn_dt IS NULL OR rsgn_dt > #{today})
SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_nm=#{value} AND bsn_part_id != CAST(#{id} AS bigint))
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.bsn_part SET bsn_part_nm=#{value},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
UPDATE mst.bsn_part SET use_yn=#{value},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE part_std_hist_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM fin.part_stlm WHERE part_std_hist_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.bsn_part_std_hist SET aply_end_ym=#{month} WHERE part_std_hist_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.select: INSERT INTO mst.bsn_part_std_hist(bsn_part_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,ldr_user_id,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt,created_by) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{input.aply_bgn_ym},NULL,NULL,#{input.ldr_nm},#{input.prft_dstrb_rt},#{input.bsn_fee_amt},#{actor}) RETURNING part_std_hist_id
